items.title: Post comment counts exclude image comments
items.precondition: An isolated database with a post, root comments, and a comment on one of the post's images.
steps: Fetch a feed or detail response containing the post.
Compare commentCount with the root-comment total.
Add and remove a root comment, then refetch.
items.expected: commentCount equals only post-level comments and changes with root-comment mutations.
items.evidence: Static review confirms a grouped post_id query with post_image_id IS NULL.
items.notes: Requires disposable database and authenticated API runtime.

items.title: Share counts are correct and batch-scoped
items.precondition: An isolated database with multiple loaded posts, including zero-share and shared posts.
steps: Fetch a feed containing the fixture posts.
Compare each shareCount to direct posts referencing that source post.
Inspect query count or focused instrumentation for the feed request.
items.expected: Each post receives its direct share count, zero is returned where appropriate, and aggregation is not executed once per post.
items.evidence: Static review confirms grouped shared_from_post_id aggregation is requested alongside other hydration work.
items.notes: Requires query instrumentation or focused integration test.

items.title: Post actions show readable and accessible counts
items.precondition: An isolated runtime with posts containing zero, positive, and more-than-99 comment/share counts.
steps: Inspect comment and share controls for each fixture.
Use an accessibility tree or screen reader to inspect their labels.
items.expected: Zero counts do not render; positive counts appear inline; 100 or more displays as 99+; accessible labels expose the full count; actions still work.
items.evidence: Static review confirms shared ActionCount rendering and count-aware aria labels.
items.notes: Requires contained browser and accessibility acceptance.

items.title: Timestamp presentation remains readable
items.precondition: An isolated runtime with comments, messages, friend rows, and posts at multiple relative ages.
steps: Compare timestamp placement and relative-time wording.
Hover or focus a comment timestamp to inspect its absolute-time title.
items.expected: Relative times are compact and understandable, and comment timestamps retain an absolute-time title.
items.evidence: Static review confirms common formatting helpers and dateTime/title attributes remain in use.
items.notes: This item records the unrelated timestamp change already present in PR #72.
